title: Keep Vera and gathering builders focused on human-authored work
detail: Model tool dispatch cannot propose authored entity fields, bios or outbound messages; introduction posting removed. Event and main Circle builder descriptions retain human source through coercion and manual fallback. Legacy Practice/Journey, small Circle suggestion and section editing remain separate. Focused source and inert/DOM consequences only; model conversational prose and image transcription still require review. No merge, deployment, provider or DB mutation.

verify.evidence: Bounded actual-source probe passed with inert IO. Cumulative integration: 35 focused suites, 411 passed, one live-provider test skipped; changed-file ESLint and full TypeScript pass. Frequency compile-only build and all six local artifact gates pass. These are cumulative local checks, not independent phase artifacts, authenticated production, provider or DB acceptance. Migration remains prepared only (OWN-109).
